learnerTask: Trace constitutional, somatic and mosaic distributions across cell lineages, rather than infer origin from one tumor or blood specimen.
scope: Two possible developmental histories plus sample windows, not mutually exclusive diagnostic bins or a pedigree. Constitutional need not be inherited; normal blood can have an acquired somatic+mosaic clone. Plasma is a DNA mixture, not a lineage. A sample does not map all reproductive cells, origin, pathogenicity, effect or transmissibility.

creationMechanism: Five actual built-in image_gen calls: initial light, three targeted light repairs, and sole-accepted-light-referenced dark; no CLI/external raster transformations
modelEvidence: Actual tool results contain image_url and output_hint only, with no model/version field
dimensionNote: Actual tool-selected light949x1658 and dark948x1659 differ slightly. They are preserved without resizing or falsely declaring identical native dimensions. Owner explicit attributes bind the light native.
objectScope: All cells/markers/rods are illustrative, not measured cell or allele fractions. Plasma has eight distinct toy rods: four marked and four plain. Stars attach to rods, never the fluid ellipse; no cells in plasma.
lineSemantics: Solid headed ancestry; thin unheaded dotted reproductive questions; thin unheaded sampling leader to Blood window; two long-dashed single-headed possible DNA contributors to Plasma.
readabilityNote: Actual accepted light labels/caption/source read at326/358CSS. Compact key/legend legible in that review; a literal44nativepx font size was not certified. Dark/pair acceptance requires separate actual review.
